security.csp: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost http://localhost:11434 http://127.0.0.1:11434; img-src 'self' asset: http://asset.localhost data: blob:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' https://fonts.googleapis.com; font-src 'self' data: https://fonts.gstatic.com; worker-src 'self' blob:

bundle.shortDescription: Desktop wiki for plain markdown vaults
bundle.longDescription: myco is a cross-platform desktop wiki app for plain markdown vaults. Edit, link, and visualize a graph of your notes with native performance.

updater.//: pubkey is EMPTY ON PURPOSE — no update channel is live yet. Run `npm run tauri -- signer generate -w ~/.tauri/myco.key`, paste the PUBLIC key (the ~/.tauri/myco.key.pub contents, one base64 line) here, and put the PRIVATE key in the TAURI_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY GitHub secret. See docs/SIGNING.md 'Part 4 — Updater signing key'. NEVER commit the private key. While this stays empty the app reports 'no update channel configured' and never calls the updater.
